description: Agent Cybersecurity: submit incident readiness records with the readiness policy: the policy with the days between drills, the minutes allowed to respond to an incident, the days between contact-tree reviews, the days allowed to close a corrective action and its text; each drill with the day it was held, its kind (tabletop, technical or full) and its scenario; each past incident with when it was detected and when response began, with their times; the contact tree with the day it was last reviewed and each entry with its role, the person named and whether they are reachable; each corrective action from a past incident with its incident, owner and the days it was opened and closed; and optionally the day the record is read on. The signed report gives the policy, the drills with the last one and its age, every incident’s minutes to response with the slow ones and the longest, the contact tree with its review and the roles with no reachable person, and the corrective actions open, overdue, closed late and unowned, and counts them, and names untested readiness: no drill recorded, a last drill past the policy’s cycle, a contact-tree role with no reachable named person and a corrective action open past the days the policy allows; then an incident answered slower than the target, drills that are all tabletop discussions, a contact tree past its review cycle, a corrective action closed late and a corrective action with no owner, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No drill cycle, no drill record, no incident record, no response target, an incident with no times to the minute, no contact tree or review cycle, no corrective actions or closing days, or no day read on leaves readiness unverified. This reads drill, response, contact and corrective records: wever_incident-plan-check reads the incident plan document, wever_incident-evidence-check reads a past incident’s claims against its timeline and wever_incident-ownership-check reads who owns, answers for and backs up each production agent, while the readiness check reads whether the response was drilled, fast, reachable and followed through. Verdict cyber_readiness_untested, cyber_readiness_partial, cyber_readiness_unverified or cyber_readiness_ready. POST /api/cyber-readiness-check. Reads the security records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, system scan, probe or external write. Agent Cybersecurity reads an organization’s own security records after the fact and checks them against the stated policy and against themselves: standing access, the secrets inventory, the component and patch record, the exported configuration, logging coverage, backup and restore evidence, a vendor’s security evidence and incident readiness. Beside it, the Agent Risk checks such as wever_risk-exposure-check read one planned action’s worst case and limits before it runs, while a cyber check reads security posture from the records; and the security reads elsewhere in the catalog keep their families, each named beside the check it meets. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-cybersecurity-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-cybersecurity/.

corrective_actions.description: Each corrective action from a past incident.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

corrective_days.description: Days allowed to close a corrective action.

response_minutes.description: Minutes allowed to respond to an incident.
